top_signals.title: ASX Rival TMX Australia to Prioritize Tech Transition From Cboe
top_signals.summary: TMX Group Ltd.’s top priority after completing its purchase of Cboe Global Markets Inc.’s Australian business will be migrating clients to its own market technology, according to the ASX Ltd. rival.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Spain defends Ceuta sovereignty after Moroccan migrant rush
top_signals.summary: Tens of thousands of migrants irregularly entered the north African territory from Morocco in an unprecedented and deadly surge.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
